response.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT raceId, points FROM constructorResults WHERE points > 1.0), race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS raceName, AVG(k.points) AS avgPoints, COUNT(*) AS resultCount FROM kept k JOIN races r ON r.raceId = k.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), name_avg AS (SELECT raceName, AVG(avgPoints) AS nameAvg FROM race_avg GROUP BY raceName) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.raceName, ra.avgPoints, ra.resultCount, ra.avgPoints / na.nameAvg AS ratio FROM race_avg ra JOIN name_avg na ON na.raceName = ra.raceName ORDER BY (ra.avgPoints / na.nameAvg IS NULL), ra.avgPoints / na.nameAvg DESC LIMIT 10;
